context: Swimlane Gantt chart showing a product launch timeline (Q1-Q2 2025) with 35 tasks across 5 teams, using 4 status colors, 17 dependency arrows, 4 milestone markers, a today line, and a brush-to-zoom overview bar at the bottom.
first_impression: Clean and well-structured — the pastel swimlane backgrounds and restrained 4-color status palette make the chart immediately readable without visual overload.
what_works: The 4-color status encoding (green/blue/red/gray) maps intuitively to completion states and stays well under the 8-color warning threshold; the subtle per-team lane shading separates teams without heavy borders while keeping the chart unified. The brush overview and milestone diamonds add useful navigational and temporal anchors.
what_doesnt: Aggressive label truncation ('Database Mi...', 'Cache Lay...', 'Rate Li...') makes the chart dependent on hover to identify many tasks, reducing at-a-glance comprehension; the 17 dependency arrows create noticeable visual noise mid-chart, particularly where cross-team dependencies converge around the current date, making it hard to trace individual dependency chains without interaction.
